description: This file defines the class 'DefaultAuthenticationResult', which implements the 'AuthenticationResult' interface. It encapsulates the result of an authentication attempt, including success or failure, associated headers, authorization context, and reason for failure.

classes.name: DefaultAuthenticationResult
classes.description: Final class implementing AuthenticationResult, representing the outcome of an authentication process with success or failure details.

methods.name: successful
methods.description: Creates a successful AuthenticationResult with given headers and authorization context.

methods.name: failed
methods.description: Creates a failed AuthenticationResult with given headers and reason for failure.

methods.name: isSuccess
methods.description: Indicates if the authentication was successful based on presence of authorization context.

methods.name: getAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Returns the authorization context if available; throws exceptions if not.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the headers associated with the authentication result.

methods.name: getReasonOfFailure
methods.description: Returns the reason for failure if authentication failed; throws exception otherwise.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on headers, authorization context, and reason for failure.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on internal fields.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object, including headers, context, and failure reason.
